name: Pathways Summer Internship
what_you_do: A short paid summer internship on Spark-Y projects around the Twin Cities. Team Lead roles guide interns aged 14 to 18.
who_can_apply: Spark-Y serves youth from 14 to 24 and up. No other requirements are listed for the internship.
pay_detail: Described as paid; the rate is not stated.
duration: Short term, annual; hours not listed
deadline_text: No dates are posted. Join the waitlist to be told first when it opens.
how_to_apply: Join the waitlist through the form on the Spark-Y Engage page.
notes: The page lists several roles. The Pathways Summer Internship is the one for newer workers. Apprenticeships fill fast.
